facts.text: I am looking to decorate my new place.
I have been living in my apartment since October 15th last year.
My personal style is modern and minimalist.
My apartment is around 700 sq ft.
My apartment is a one-bedroom.
My apartment layout is pretty open-plan.
I like neutral colors like beige, gray, and white.
I want to make the most of the natural light in my apartment.
My budget for decorating is around $2,000 to $3,000.
I recently turned 30.
I want my apartment to reflect that I am feeling like it's time to take my life more seriously.
I like the idea of a neutral background and light-filled living.
I want to add personal touches to make the space feel more like home.
I want something that will remind me of my recent accomplishments, like my marathon or triathlon.
I plan to use a medal display rack.
I plan to add personalized artwork.
For the artwork, I was thinking of a stylized representation of my marathon route.
I want subtle design elements in the artwork that reflect my personality.
I want recommendations for a good artist or platform to commission the artwork from.
I think I will go with a freelance artist from Upwork.
I like the idea of reviewing portfolios and bids before selecting an artist.
I want tips on how to write a clear and effective project description to get the best bids from artists.
I will write a clear and effective project description that outlines my requirements and expectations.
I will review the artists' portfolios and bids carefully to find the best fit for my project.

keyphrases: neutral color palette beige gray white
personal touches make it feel like home
